status.summary: TierPoint's Chicago page, in its version modified on 3 September 2026, says 'Just west of the Loop in the heart of Chicago, the state-of-the-art TierPoint Chicago (Polk St.) data center and colocation facility enables companies in many industries to increase business agility' and that the Chicago area hosts one of TierPoint's multitenant cloud pods. It gives 601 W Polk St, Chicago, IL 60607, 107,000+ total square feet, 16,000+ square feet of raised floor, two 2.25 MW redundant generators, DWDM connectivity to 350 E Cermak, 24x7x365 on-site security and 24x7 remote hands. This records the facility as operating on 3 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version (bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 15 July 2026 and above by the 26 October 2026 capture); it is not an opening date, and generator ratings are not IT load.

additions.successor_review: TierPoint's data-centers overview page captured on 26 October 2026 (us-midwest-plains-p2-tierpoint-data-centers-overview; structured-data modification 1 October 2026) still lists the Chicago - Polk Data Center, and TierPoint's news sitemap (captured 26 October 2026) has nothing after 12 August 2026 and no closure, sale, pause or expansion item for it. The project stays operational as of 3 September 2026.
